Senior Software Engineer
Location: Vilnius or Kaunas (Office-Based/Hybrid)

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve core components of iModel Cloud Sync Services. This role focuses on developing reliable, scalable cloud services that ingest, transform, and synchronize engineering data from diverse sources into the iTwin platform.
As a Senior Engineer, you will work hands‑on with distributed systems and cloud‑native technologies, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate closely with product managers, architects, and other engineers to deliver robust, production‑grade solutions.

Software Design & Development
Design, implement, and maintain cloud‑based synchronization and ETL services that transform engineering data into iModels.
Build distributed, event‑driven, and task‑oriented systems using microservices, messaging, and containerized workloads.
Contribute to the design of workflow orchestration mechanisms, including state‑driven execution, retries, and long‑running tasks.
Develop services that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements for global, multi‑tenant deployments.
Cloud Platform & Distributed Systems
Implement microservices and data pipelines using Azure, Kubernetes, containers, and cloud‑native primitives.
Follow best practices for CI/CD, zero‑downtime deployments, configuration management, and secret handling.
Implement concurrency control, idempotency, and conflict‑resolution patterns in distributed workflows.
Build and maintain observability features, including structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
Data & ETL Workflows
Develop ETL pipelines for parsing, validation, transformation, and mapping of engineering data formats.
Implement schema management and versioning strategies for synchronization workflows.
Ensure pipelines support deterministic execution, fault tolerance, and transactional consistency.
Reliability & Operational Excellence
Implement resilience patterns such as retries, backoff strategies, circuit breakers, and rate limiting.
Participate in design and code reviews with a focus on maintainability, security, and operational readiness.
Help diagnose production issues and contribute to root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement.
Collaboration & Technical Growth
Collaborate with architects and principal engineers on design and implementation decisions.
Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best practices.
Contribute to shared engineering standards, documentation, and technical knowledge bases.

Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
7+ years of professional experience in software engineering with exposure to distributed or cloud based systems.
Strong experience with Azure, microservices, containers, and Kubernetes.
Hands on experience building ETL pipelines, workflow based systems, or event driven architectures.
Proficiency in one or more languages such as C#.
Solid understanding of observability, CI/CD, reliability, and cloud operations.
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to deliver production quality software.

ORDERYOYO Senior Software Engineer – Payments Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary About the Role At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

Role Mission Own and evolve OrderYOYO 's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.
Must-Have Requirements Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
Strong-to-Have Experience Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).
Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.
Who We Are At OrderYOYO , company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build.

Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve. We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business.

By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably. Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe. What We Offer
· Competitive salary. A remote role — work from wherever you do your best work, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

· High ownership and autonomy. Clear progression toward Tech Lead / Staff Engineer responsibilities.
The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.
A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.
A collaborative, international engineering team.
Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and long-term growth.

About Dune
Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, & investors to understand the on-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of ~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones ️.

We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more.
We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards ‍♀️
If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains.

Dune's Vision
Values and working at Dune
As a software engineer in Dune focused on Data you will play a key role in ensuring our data platform scales to accommodate an ever-growing volume of blockchain data. This is a role that involves thinking about large scale distributed systems and distributed databases, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics.

s.h: We are building a data platform that
s.t:
Can ingest and process petabytes of data
Allows third parties to ingest data
Facilitates performant SQL queries across datasets

Design and develop distributed systems in a principled way and take part in high impact architectural decisions
Engage in stimulating technical challenges in topics such as distributed systems, very large databases, SQL processing, data modelling, or systems performance
Assume ownership of components within our blockchain data platform such as data ingestion and decoding
Write code mostly in Kotlin and Go with some Java and Rust with a strong emphasis on good design and performance
Contribute to the internal developer experience by improving local test setups, integration tests, and incremental deployment processes.
Continually improve how we operate the platform, including seeking opportunities to automate incident diagnosis and resolution using AI
Work with one of the fastest engineering teams in the industry.

s.h: You might be a great fit for this role if
s.t:
You are a strong generalist with fundamental computer science knowledge. You use this knowledge to easily adapt to new technologies and scenarios, and to find the right solutions for the problems at hand.
You have an understanding of distributed system design, or the drive to learn if you’re a more junior engineer. Our work is as much about understanding and designing systems as it is about coding in a particular language.
Have an understanding of blockchain technology and RPC interactions
Have experience with datalakes and formats like parquet, delta, iceberg
You have great collaboration and communication skills. We work on the principle that the best output emerges from effective team work and constructive discussions.
Coding experience in any JVM language, along with a zeal for writing well-designed, testable software

A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard
We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).
On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag ! ✌️

As an Intermediate Software Engineer on GitLab’s Vulnerability Management team, you’ll help build the core security workflows that GitLab Ultimate customers use to triage, prioritize, and act on vulnerabilities. You’ll work primarily in Ruby on Rails on backend systems, including security dashboards, vulnerability reports, and ingestion pipelines.

You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects, solve technical problems with support from experienced team members, and collaborate with other engineers. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute beyond the backend when the work requires it.
You will join a fullstack team, working together with product managers, designers, and frontend engineers to solve problems across the Vulnerability Management domain.

Develop and maintain backend features for GitLab’s vulnerability management workflows.
Confidently ship features and improvements with minimal guidance and support from other team members; collaborate with the team on larger projects.
Help improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of security data ingestion and reporting systems.
Collaborate with frontend engineers and contribute across the stack when needed.

Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions

Experience building and maintaining backend applications with Ruby on Rails.

The Vulnerability Management team develops the core security workflows that help GitLab customers triage and manage vulnerabilities. The team owns areas including the security dashboard, vulnerability reports, and ingestion pipelines, and serves as an important interface for security-related features across GitLab.

The team is focused on moving beyond lists of findings toward workflows that help customers prioritize and coordinate remediation. You’ll collaborate asynchronously with a small, distributed group and with related security teams, including the Agentic Security Flows team.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.
Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.
We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.
Why we’re hiring
We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.
You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.
We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.
Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.
Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.
A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.
Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.
Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.
Probably not for you if
You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.
The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.
The hiring process
Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.
Call with Imani, our Head of People and Talent . You'll get a proper picture of the role and the company, and we'll get into how you work and how you build.
System design session with our engineering team . No leetcode and no take-home. We want to see how you approach a problem and structure a solution.
Paid trial day. A real Odin problem with everything you need handed to you. You see how we work, we see how you ship.
Working at Odin
Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in Europe with quarterly trips to London.

Our Purpose
At SentinelOne , we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever.

When you join SentinelOne , your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will help secure tens of millions of devices across Windows, Linux, and macOS while processing billions of security events every day as part of SentinelOne ’s Endpoint Protection product line.
We are looking for an excellent software engineer with a reliability-first mindset who thrives on solving complex distributed systems challenges in production and turning those learnings into durable platform improvements and long-term engineering ownership.
You’ll help drive customer-critical incident response across the Agent Platform, rapidly build context across multiple platform services, and partner with engineering teams to continuously improve the platform’s reliability, operability, and scalability as a whole.
You will build and evolve the high-throughput, highly available services responsible for policy, configuration, and command distribution to millions of agents worldwide, while contributing to the agent platform protocols that enable other SentinelOne teams to deliver new security capabilities safely and at scale.
This role offers broad technical ownership, the opportunity to work across service boundaries, and the ability to influence the design and reliability of critical platform capabilities used throughout the Agent Platform at SentinelOne . You’ll solve some of the company’s most complex production challenges while helping shape the future of our platform.
What Will You Do?

Drive rapid response to customer-critical incidents by diagnosing, triaging, and resolving complex production issues that span multiple services across the Agent Platform.
Lead systematic root-cause analysis and translate incident learnings into durable reliability, scalability, observability, and operability improvements.
Quickly build a systems-level understanding of unfamiliar services and codebases, collaborating closely with engineering teams to resolve complex cross-service issues.
Design, develop, test, document, deploy, and operate large-scale, high-volume, low-latency distributed systems processing millions of events per second.
Understand, maintain, and continuously improve existing services through refactoring, feature development, and architectural enhancements.
Maintain application stability and data integrity by monitoring key metrics, improving operational visibility, and continuously strengthening the codebase.
Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, and operable technical solutions.
Partner closely with engineering teams across SentinelOne to solve cross-functional problems, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that scale.
Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies that improve the platform’s scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
Your Toolkit
Our backend services are primarily developed in Java , with Go and Python also playing important roles.
We use gRPC, REST, GraphQL, and Kafka for service communication.
Our data layer includes Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ClickHouse , and our own columnar time-series database.
Our services run across multiple AWS and GCP regions on Kubernetes , using Docker, GitHub, and ArgoCD .
We provide engineers with modern AI-powered tools to improve both engineering productivity and software quality.
What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep expertise in at least one of Java, Go, or Python , and the willingness to work across all three as needed.
A reliability-first mindset with a proven ability to solve complex production incidents, perform systematic root-cause analysis, and implement durable engineering solutions that prevent recurrence.
Demonstrated ability to quickly understand unfamiliar distributed systems, navigate large codebases, and troubleshoot complex failures across service boundaries.
Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a deep understanding of failure modes, performance trade-offs, resilience patterns, and operational excellence.
Experience with AWS, GCP , or similar cloud platforms, as well as Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes .
Experience with messaging systems and data platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, ClickHouse , or similar technologies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, Product, Technical Account Managers, and other stakeholders, influence technical direction, and mentor fellow engineers.
A high degree of ownership, autonomy, curiosity, and the ability to drive ambiguous technical problems to successful outcomes.
Experience in an enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity software company is highly desirable.
Why SentinelOne ?
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.
Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*.

"Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.
Up to this point, the Stability team at Mercury has primarily built platform-level constructs that product teams adopt. However, those teams are asking for us to work more closely with them to mature their implementations and practices. We are creating an SRE team that will rotate through product teams. You will understand the team's domain, identify opportunities for improvements in reliability/observability/performance/preparedness and create self-reinforcing, virtuous cycles.

Embed with product teams, helping them improve their operational maturity by setting up and refining practices around on-call, monitoring, alerting, and run books
Run regular game day exercises with product teams, helping them feel more prepared to investigate and quickly remediate incidents
Jump into application code written in Haskell & TypeScript and implement reliability techniques such as retries, better error handling, better logging, circuit breaking, etc
Steer SLOs towards meaningful customer outcomes that product teams are accountable for. Those SLOs become a strong signal for whether the product is working as intended
Champion reliability practices through design document and code reviews
Identify observability gaps that hinder debugging, incident response, and business intelligence and help close those
Advocate for longer-term improvements that non-product engineering teams can drive
Participate in the product team's on-call rotation while embedding or as part of a more general engineering rotation, helping us improve processes and how we learn from incidents

Has past Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps experience
Has measurable examples of influencing an organization towards greater reliability
Has significant experience with PostgreSQL
Has authored and operated Temporal workflows
Has experience with observability platforms like Grafana or Honeycomb
Has familiarity with OpenTelemetry

## Description de l'entreprise ##
**Swiss Medical Network** est l'un des groupes de cliniques privées les plus importants de Suisse. Il s'est fixé pour objectif d'offrir des soins médicaux de premier ordre à ses patients suisses et étrangers.

Swiss Medical Network convainc par la haute qualité de ses prestations, un environnement de travail agréable et une équipe de direction expérimentée à l'esprit entrepreneurial. Le réseau exploite actuellement 21 cliniques et hôpitaux dans toute la Suisse et est présent dans les trois principales régions linguistiques.
## Description du poste ##
En tant que **Fullstack Developer (AI & Digital Health)**, vous jouez un rôle moteur dans la transformation numérique de nos cliniques. Vous concevez et développez des solutions logicielles innovantes assistées par l'IA, qui améliorent le parcours du patient tout en soulageant le personnel médical. Vous agissez comme un pont technique entre les exigences médicales et les technologies de pointe, garantissant que nos applications de santé numériques sont sécurisées, évolutives et conviviales.

**Votre domaine d'activité**
* **Développement & Architecture de solutions :** Conception et implémentation d'applications web Fullstack évolutives (Frontend & Backend) pour un usage clinique et administratif.
* **Intégration de l'IA :** Développement et intégration de modèles d'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning), de LLM (Large Language Models) et de services d'IA déterministes (explainable AI) dans des applications existantes et nouvelles pour soutenir les processus diagnostiques ou administratifs.
* **Données & Interfaces :** Connexion des applications aux systèmes primaires cliniques (KIS/HIS/DPI) en utilisant des standards d'interopérabilité modernes (ex. FHIR, HL7) et garantie d'un échange de données fluide.
* **Security by Design :** Garantie des standards de sécurité les plus élevés et de la conformité à la protection des données (LPD/RGPD) lors du traitement des données sensibles des patients, en étroite coordination avec le délégué à la protection des données.
* **DevOps & Cloud :** Mise en place et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD ainsi que gestion de l'infrastructure Cloud pour l'exploitation des solutions d'IA.
* **Prototyping :** Développement rapide de preuves de concept (PoC) pour évaluer le potentiel des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour le quotidien clinique et les rendre tangibles.
* **Collaboration :** Étroite coopération avec les Data Scientists, les médecins et le personnel soignant afin de créer des solutions centrées sur l'utilisateur ("User Centricity").
**Votre profil**
* **Formation :** Diplôme universitaire en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou qualification comparable avec un fort accent sur les technologies web modernes.
* **Compétences en développement :** Expérience approfondie dans les frameworks Backend (ex. Python, Node.js, Java) et Frontend (ex. React, Angular, Vue.js) modernes, idéalement sur la Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Looker). Des connaissances en Python sont privilégiées en raison de l'orientation IA.
* **Expertise en IA :** Expérience pratique dans l'intégration de composants IA/ML (ex. API OpenAI, LangChain, Hugging Face, TensorFlow) dans des environnements logiciels productifs.
* **Secteur de la santé :** Une expérience avec les normes du secteur de la santé (FHIR, HL7, DICOM) est un avantage, mais pas obligatoire si vous êtes prêt à vous y former. Une expérience avec le "Software as Medical Device" et les processus de certification correspondants constitue un atout majeur.
* **Méthode de travail :** Un mode de travail autonome, agile (Scrum/Kanban) et orienté solutions. Vous avez une mentalité "Can-Do" et prenez plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes par le code.
* **Personnalité :** Esprit d'innovation couplé à une conscience de la qualité. Vous savez rendre des sujets techniques compréhensibles pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.
* **Langues :** De langue maternelle allemande avec un niveau courant/négociation en français (ou inversement) ; de bonnes connaissances en anglais sont requises pour la collaboration au sein de nos équipes linguistiques régionales.
* **Tech-Stack :** Des connaissances en technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plateformes Cloud (Azure/GCP) et gestion de versions (Git) sont prérequis.
## Informations supplémentaires ##
**Notre offre**
* **Innovation :** Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l'innovation médicale et de développer des solutions d'IA qui apportent une véritable plus-value à la vie des patients.
* **Création :** Vous bénéficiez d'une grande marge de manœuvre technique dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise les circuits de décision courts et la pensée entrepreneuriale.
* **Environnement :** Un climat de travail inspirant au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire composée de médecins et de spécialistes IT, un package salarial attractif ainsi que des prestations sociales progressistes vous attendent.
* **Développement :** Réjouissez-vous de projets passionnants avec les dernières technologies et une grande responsabilité personnelle au sein d'un groupe de cliniques en pleine croissance.

⭐️ Reports to: Director of Engineering

We are looking for a deeply hands-on Principal Software Engineer to be the most senior technical individual contributor at Hi Rasmus . Reporting to our Director of Engineering, this is a role on our Principal track, a craft career path that sits alongside the management track rather than beneath it.
Where a Lead Software Engineer is the strongest technical contributor within one outcome team, the Principal Software Engineer works across all of them. You will help shape and evolve our platform architecture, strengthen shared technical practices, mentor Senior and Lead Engineers, and take on complex challenges that span teams or domains.
This is not an advisory role. You will work alongside teams in the code, helping solve difficult problems and piloting new tools, patterns, and practices through real work. Your goal is not to become a permanent escalation point, but to leave teams more capable of making strong technical decisions independently.
You lead through technical judgement, architecture, code review, collaboration and example rather than through reporting lines. Software Engineers sit in the outcome teams and report to their Lead Engineer.

You will provide technical guidance and mentorship across teams, while people leadership, performance management, staffing and overall Engineering accountability remain with Lead Engineers and the Director of Engineering. As we scale, we are relying increasingly on AI and automation to improve engineering leverage.

Working in partnership with the Director of Engineering and CTO, you will help translate our company and Engineering direction into sound architecture, modern technical practices, and durable internal capability.

Work alongside outcome teams to solve complex technical problems, particularly those spanning systems, teams, or domains.
Pilot new tools, patterns, and practices through real production work before supporting broader adoption.
Facilitate the architecture forum, bringing Product and other stakeholders into decisions early and establishing a clear process for documenting, communicating, and revisiting those decisions.
Partner with the Director of Engineering, CTO, and Lead Engineers to guide the evolution of our web and mobile platform across Vue 3, Quasar, Capacitor, Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform.
Evaluate and recommend tooling and framework decisions, including build, buy, adopt, or retire recommendations grounded in real evidence and business needs.
Take on the complex, cross-cutting problems that span teams or that no single team can own, and land them in production.
Establish shared technical standards across code quality, testing, APIs, data modelling, documentation, and system design, building adoption through practical value, review, and example.
Surface technical debt, performance, scalability, and system-health risks early, and partner with Engineering leadership to prioritize the right investments.
Strengthen internal ownership of critical systems, architectural decisions, deployment paths, and operational knowledge through clear documentation, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on collaboration.
Build alignment across teams through the Lead Engineers guild while preserving the ownership and autonomy of individual outcome teams.
Advance responsible AI-assisted development practices and evaluate their impact on quality, speed, reliability, privacy, and security. Help scale what works and thoughtfully retire practices that no longer serve us.
Identify technical risk, performance, and scalability problems before they are urgent, and lead the work to remove them.
Mentor Senior and Lead Engineers through pairing, design review, technical feedback, and shared problem-solving.
Contribute to the engineering career ladder and to levelling and calibration, and act as the technical assessor in engineering hiring, with decisions owned by Lead Engineers and the Director of Engineering.
Partner with the Principal QA Engineer, Product, and DevOps so that quality, testability, and operability are designed in rather than added later.
Contribute to compliance and audit readiness by helping make sure our technical practices hold up to external scrutiny in a regulated healthcare context.

¿Qué es?
Es un profesional especializado en el desarrollo, integración y adaptación de sistemas operativos embebidos (como Embedded Linux o RTOS) para ECUs (Unidades de Control Electrónico), con enfoque en la replicación y optimización de un Test OS en plataformas automotrices.
¿Cómo lo hace?
Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.
Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.
Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.
Automatiza pruebas (SIL, HIL y a nivel vehicular) para validar el comportamiento de las ECUs y los componentes conectados.
Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.
¿Por qué es crucial?
Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).

Lenguajes: C (avanzado +5 años), C++ (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), Python (intermedio 2-5 años), Bash (intermedio 2-5 años).
Sistemas operativos embebidos: Embedded Linux (avanzado +5 años), RTOS (avanzado +5 años).
Protocolos de comunicación: CAN, CAN FD, UDS (avanzado +5 años), DoIP, Automotive Ethernet (intermedio 2-5 años).
Herramientas: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape (avanzado +5 años), GDB, JTAG (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Pruebas automatizadas: GoogleTest, pytest (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), SIL, HIL (avanzado +5 años).
CI/CD y control de versiones: Git (avanzado +5 años), Jenkins, GitLab CI (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Firmware para ECUs: Integración, flasheo, diagnósticos (DIDs, DTCs) (avanzado +5 años).
Estándares: ASPICE, MISRA C (avanzado +5 años).
Visa (Obligatorio) - Viajaran a USA por el equipo de cliente

s.h: Análisis y adaptación del Test OS
s.t:
Analizar la arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue del Test OS implementado en vehículos Gen2.
Portar el Test OS a las ECUs Gen1 de RVT, asegurando compatibilidad con el hardware existente.

Desarrollar capas de abstracción de plataforma para facilitar la comunicación, control y monitoreo de las ECUs.
Implementar módulos de software para integración de diagnósticos, flasheo de firmware y adquisición de datos.

Integrar diagnósticos de ECU (DIDs, DTCs) usando protocolos como UDS y DoIP.
Implementar rutinas de flasheo de firmware para actualizaciones seguras en las ECUs.
Configurar sistemas de logging y monitoreo de salud para registrar y analizar datos en tiempo real.

Diseñar y desarrollar pruebas SIL (Software-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en entornos simulados.
Crear pruebas HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) para validar el software en conjunto con hardware real.
Implementar pruebas a nivel vehicular para validar el comportamiento del sistema en condiciones reales.

Depurar problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) en las ECUs.
Colaborar con equipos de ECU, eléctrica, sistemas, validación y hardware para identificar y resolver brechas de plataforma.

Trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios para asegurar la integración y validación del Test OS en Gen1.
Documentar procesos, cambios y resultados de las pruebas y adaptaciones realizadas.

Asegurar que el desarrollo del software cumpla con estándares como ASPICE y MISRA C.
Validar que las soluciones implementadas cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y calidad del cliente.

.NET/C# sólido. Es el backend del producto y ahí esperamos fuerza real. Python, que usan los servicios que consumes, se aprende acá.
React de cara al cliente. No necesitas ser el referente de front, pero sí construir features completas y sostener las convenciones del squad.
Clean Architecture aplicada, no leída. Inversión de control, dominio aislado de la infraestructura, el tecnologías específicas como piezas desechables: arquitectura evolutiva de verdad.
Testing como parte del entregable. Cobertura unitaria más tests de integración que levantan las piezas del caso de uso, con terceros simulados. Acá no hay QA: cada equipo prueba hasta donde el riesgo quede manejado.
Diagnóstico de performance e incidentes. Leer señales de la aplicación —observabilidad, trazas, métricas— y concluir qué dicen del software. La base de datos es un caso concreto: leer el plan de ejecución en vez de adivinarlo, índices, escaneos de tabla.
Tomar cualquier tarea técnica del producto, de punta a punta. React en el front de cara al cliente, .NET en el backend y Python en los servicios que ese backend consume. No entras a cubrir un hueco de tecnología: entras para que el squad pueda avanzar en los tres frentes a la vez, sin mayor acompañamiento.
Mandar a producción rápido para aprender del uso real. Valoramos llegar a tiempo al mercado, así que muchas decisiones se toman sabiendo que dejan deuda. Cada sprint reserva un espacio que planifica el propio equipo para robustecer lo que ya se validó como core: distinguir qué deuda se paga y cuál se deja viva es parte del rol.
Desarrollar con agentes y con contención. Vamos hacia un enfoque agéntico antes que de supervisión humana, y eso se sostiene con tests y restricciones alrededor de lo que hace el agente, no con fe.
Compartir el objetivo de negocio. El norte es el mismo para todo el squad: quienes vienen del lado de producto y quienes vienen del lado técnico persiguen el mismo resultado. Entiendes la tesis de negocio detrás de un requerimiento antes de implementarlo, y descartas rápido lo que no funciona.
Construir para el Maxxa que viene. Ya operamos en México y estamos evaluando el próximo país. El segmento al que apunta este producto —la empresa chica, la que nadie financia— es el mismo en toda la región, y lo que validemos acá es lo que se lleva.
Sostener el estándar sin autoridad formal. El producto se apoya en servicios que construyen otros equipos de Tecnología. No los diriges: los alineas, con criterio propio sobre qué aceptas recibir.
Cómo se ve que vas bien. Tomas tareas de complejidad creciente sin acompañamiento, los flujos que tocas quedan con su cobertura de tests y empiezas a proponer qué se robustece. Eso es lo que miramos, y se conversa contigo desde el primer día.
Haber construido en un producto en validación de mercado , no solo en líneas maduras y estables.
Haber aprendido un stack o tecnología nueva sobre la marcha y haber llegado a ser productivo rápido en ella.

# Ingénieur logiciel systèmes HPC - OpenCHAMI pour Lugano ou Zurich #
**Le Centre national suisse de superinformatique (CSCS)** développe et exploite une infrastructure de recherche en calcul haute performance et données qui soutient une science de classe mondiale en Suisse. Son laboratoire utilisateur est accessible aux chercheurs nationaux et internationaux du milieu académique, industriel et commercial. Le centre est exploité par l-ETH Zurich et dispose de bureaux dans son centre de données à Lugano et à Zurich.
## Contexte du projet ##

**OpenCHAMI** signifie **Open Composable Heterogeneous Adaptable Management Infrastructure**. Il s-agit d-un projet open source qui fournit des outils modernes de gestion et de provisionnement des systèmes pour les clusters et superordinateurs de **calcul haute performance (HPC)**. Le projet, avec un financement limité et donc une durée de contrat limitée, vise à apporter des capacités de déploiement, d-automatisation et de sécurité similaires à celles du cloud aux environnements HPC.
Ce projet, avec lieu de travail à Lugano ou Zurich, se concentre sur le développement et l-avancement d-OpenCHAMI pour l-infrastructure de superinformatique de nouvelle génération du CSCS. Le travail contribuera à construire une approche ouverte, évolutive et moderne de la gestion des clusters pour les systèmes HPC à grande échelle.
L-objectif principal est de concevoir, développer, intégrer et déployer les capacités d-OpenCHAMI adaptées aux exigences opérationnelles des superordinateurs du CSCS.
Le projet abordera les défis liés à la gestion de systèmes HPC et IA de plus en plus complexes et contribuera à l-évolution des technologies open source de gestion de clusters de nouvelle génération.

Nous valorisons l-excellence technique, la curiosité, l-initiative et la capacité d-apprendre et de grandir plus qu-une liste parfaite de compétences. Travailler sur l-infrastructure HPC de nouvelle génération nécessite une volonté d-explorer de nouvelles technologies, de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer continuellement de nouvelles expertises.
Si vous êtes motivé à avoir un impact significatif dans ce domaine mais ne remplissez pas tous les critères, nous vous encourageons vivement à postuler.

Nous proposons un contrat initial de deux ans offrant la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l-infrastructure HPC et IA au CSCS, contribuant directement au développement de technologies qui soutiendront les futurs systèmes de superinformatique.
Vous aurez l-opportunité de contribuer à OpenCHAMI et aux initiatives open source associées, en collaborant avec la communauté HPC au sens large et en participant à des programmes à fort impact aux niveaux national et international, notamment HPSF, OpenCHAMI et initiatives connexes.
C-est une occasion de contribuer à la manière dont les futurs superordinateurs du CSCS seront gérés, surveillés et exploités, tout en participant à des technologies open source ayant un impact bien au-delà d-un seul système ou établissement.
## Description du poste ##
* Développer et étendre OpenCHAMI pour répondre aux exigences de gestion d-infrastructure et opérationnelles des systèmes de superinformatique actuels et de nouvelle génération du CSCS.
* Contribuer à l-écosystème open source OpenCHAMI, y compris le développement, l-intégration et l-évolution des services et composants de gestion de clusters associés.
* Développer des workflows d-automatisation et de gestion pour améliorer le provisionnement, la configuration, la surveillance, la maintenance et l-efficacité opérationnelle des systèmes à grande échelle.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles HPC pour comprendre les exigences et défis opérationnels, et les traduire en solutions robustes, évolutives et maintenables basées sur OpenCHAMI.
* Contribuer à l-architecture et à l-évolution de la plateforme OpenCHAMI, en veillant à ce que les solutions soient évolutives, fiables, maintenables et alignées sur les besoins des systèmes HPC et IA à grande échelle.
* Participer activement aux workflows de développement open source, incluant la conception logicielle, l-implémentation, les tests, les revues de code, le suivi des problèmes et les discussions techniques au sein de la communauté OpenCHAMI.
* Collaborer avec des partenaires internationaux et la communauté HPC au sens large pour développer et intégrer des solutions qui font progresser la gestion open source des clusters et l-automatisation des infrastructures.
* Produire et maintenir la documentation technique, incluant les conceptions architecturales, guides d-implémentation, procédures opérationnelles et bonnes pratiques.
* Évaluer les technologies émergentes et approches pertinentes pour la gestion, l-observabilité et l-automatisation des infrastructures HPC, et contribuer à leur adoption lorsque cela est approprié.
## Profil ##
Nous accueillons des ingénieurs de divers horizons désireux de contribuer à notre mission. Nous recherchons principalement de solides bases techniques, un bon jugement en ingénierie et la capacité de combler les écarts entre les domaines. La curiosité, l-adaptabilité, la volonté d-apprendre sur le terrain et le potentiel de croissance comptent plus pour nous qu-une correspondance parfaite initiale des exigences techniques.
Les technologies listées ci-dessous illustrent l-étendue de notre stack et nos domaines d-intérêt. Elles ne constituent pas une liste de critères, et une expérience dans seulement certains de ces domaines est attendue.
**Environnement technique et domaines d-intérêt**
* Langage de programmation Go
* Git et workflows modernes de développement logiciel
* CI/CD (Gitlab, GitHub, Ansible)
* Technologies de conteneurs (Docker, Podman)
* Développement logiciel open source
* Frameworks de test, pratiques de qualité logicielle et approches DevOps/GitOps
**Qualités personnelles :**
* Autonome, proactif, concentré et collaboratif
* Esprit de résolution de problèmes solide et à l-aise avec des problèmes complexes ou ambigus
* Communicateur clair avec un fort sens des besoins des utilisateurs
* Ouvert à l-apprentissage de nouvelles technologies et au travail interdisciplinaire
* À l-aise pour demander de l-aide et mobiliser l-expertise appropriée lorsque nécessaire
**Modes de travail :**
* Capacité à s-épanouir dans des environnements collaboratifs et auto-organisés inspirés des principes Agile
* Expérience avec des pratiques de développement structurées telles que le développement piloté par les tests est un plus
**Nos valeurs fondamentales comme principes directeurs :**
* **Curiosité :** Vous aimez apprendre, explorer de nouvelles idées et comprendre les problèmes en profondeur.
* **Ouverture :** Vous écoutez, collaborez et êtes réceptif à différentes perspectives.
* **Courage :** Vous abordez des problèmes difficiles ou ambigus et êtes prêt à prendre des initiatives.
* **Soutien :** Vous aidez collègues et utilisateurs à réussir et contribuez à une culture d-équipe positive.
